title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
abstract: arXiv:2611.29444v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. translated_title: RumiFold：教会大语言模型原生折叠蛋白质并推理其功能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.29444v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们能否教会一个通用语言模型折叠蛋白质？如果能，学习折叠在结构预测本身之外还能带来什么？我们提出了RumiFold，一个预训练的对话模型，它学会直接从自身的隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构。RumiFold通过反复的折叠过程来处理蛋白质，然后利用这些折叠后的表示以自然语言回答问题。它实现了与SimpleFold等专用单一表示模型相当的折叠精度，同时在Gene Ontology蛋白质功能预测和自由文本功能描述任务上达到了最先进的性能。我们发现折叠预训练使模型的隐藏状态围绕蛋白质功能进行组织，创建了一个具有生物学基础的内部逐残基工作空间。因果干预实验表明，当RumiFold预测蛋白质功能时，这个折叠工作空间将结构与语言联系起来，为其提供了丰富的表示。
tldr: 提出RumiFold，一个通过折叠预训练学会直接从自身隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构、并以自然语言推理蛋白质功能的对话模型，其折叠精度可媲美专用折叠模型，并在蛋白质功能预测上达到最先进水平。
en_tdlr: RumiFold is a pretrained chat model that learns to natively fold proteins from its own hidden states and reason about their function in natural language, achieving folding accuracy comparable to dedicated models and state-of-the-art protein function prediction.
